please_enter_the_one_time_password_to_ve: Please enter the one time password to verify your account

mailbox_connect_expired: The sign-in took too long. Please try again.
mailbox_connect_not_on_domain: Only mailboxes on the shop's own domain can be connected.
mailbox_connect_failed: Google did not connect the mailbox. Please try again.
inbox_no_mailboxes: You have not been given any mailbox yet. Ask the super admin to give you access in Settings › Mailboxes.
inbox_needs_reconnect: {{address}} needs reconnecting. Ask the super admin to reconnect it in Settings › Mailboxes. Gmail on the web still works meanwhile.
inbox_gmail_unavailable: Gmail is not answering. Try again in a minute; Gmail on the web still works.
inbox_search: Search mail (for example from:rahul or has:attachment)
inbox_attach_help: Up to 10 files, 10 MB in all.
inbox_pictures_hidden: Pictures are hidden, because they can tell the sender when this message is opened.
inbox_pick_conversation: Choose a conversation to read it.
inbox_need_recipient: Add at least one address in To.
inbox_files_too_big: The attachments are over 10 MB in all.
inbox_no_access: You don't have access to the mailbox "{{name}}". Showing one you can open.
inbox_empty_inbox: No conversations. New mail shows here within a minute.
inbox_empty_trash: Trash is empty. Gmail empties it by itself after 30 days.
inbox_thread_gone: This conversation was moved or deleted in Gmail.
inbox_read_only_note: You can read this mailbox. Ask the super admin for Send access.
inbox_contact_form: Sent through the Contact Us form
inbox_close_reply: Close the reply (your text is kept)
inbox_collision: {{name}} has replied since you started this reply ({{minutes}} min ago).
inbox_check_addresses: Check the addresses marked in red.
inbox_no_signature: {{address}} has no Gmail signature, so nothing is added below your message.
inbox_discard_body: What you wrote will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
inbox_runnable_body: "{{name}}" can run programs on your computer. Download it only if you expected it from this sender.
inbox_not_spam_done: Marked as not spam and moved to Inbox.
inbox_from_rejected: This From address can no longer send. Choose another From address.
inbox_read_only: You can only read this mailbox.
inbox_send_reconnect: This mailbox needs reconnecting before it can send.
inbox_gmail_busy: Gmail is busy. Wait a moment and send again.
inbox_not_sent: Not sent: Gmail did not answer.
name: Name
redirect_rejected: That redirect was rejected. The path is already used, or it would loop.

would_you_prefer_to_pay_using_points?: Would you prefer to pay using points?
would_you_prefer_to_pay_using_wallet?: Would you prefer to pay using wallet?
title: Title
min_order_free_shipping_is_required: Min order free shipping is required
label: Label

media_deleted_message: This image leaves the library now, and its files are erased for good after 30 days.
confirmation_massage: Are you sure you want to proceed?
opps!!_There_are_no_result_found: Opps!! There are no result found.

page_not_found_text: We'are sorry, the page you requested could not be found.it looks like nothing was found at this location.Please go back to the homepage
if_your_pin_is_locked_sign_in_with_your_: If your PIN is locked, sign in with your password.
something_went_wrong_please_try_again: Something went wrong. Please try again.
invalid_or_expired_reset_link: That reset link is not valid or has expired.
if_the_details_are_correct_we_have_sent_: If the details are correct, we have sent you an email.
password_must_be_at_least_12_characters: Password must be at least 12 characters.
paste_the_code_from_your_recovery_email: Paste the code from your recovery email
session_locked_message: Confirm your presence to continue where you left off.
pin_locked_hint: A password sign-in, or setting a new PIN, clears this lock.
pin_revalidation_hint: Sign in once with your password to use the PIN again.
password_change_signs_out: Changing your password signs you out of every device, including this one.
msg91_authkey_env_only_hint: MSG91 Authkey is set only in API environment variables — never pasted here.
banner_image_desktop_help: Required. Shown from 1200 px wide. Upload at 2880 px wide for full-width banners.
banner_image_tablet_help: Optional. Shown from 768 to 1199 px, and on phones turned sideways; falls back to the desktop image.
banner_image_phone_help: Shown on phones held upright, below 768 px. Portrait 1080×1350 or square 1080×1080. Required on wide banners whose image contains text.
banner_contains_text_help: Off (recommended): upload a photo without text and type the heading below, so it translates and stays readable. On: the words are part of the image.
banner_alt_repeat_text_help: The image contains words: repeat them in the alt text for screen readers and search engines.
youtube_validate_required: Press Validate to confirm the video before saving.
product_video_paste: Paste a YouTube video or Shorts link
product_video_check_help: A pasted link is checked at once: the video must be public, and its title, length and whether it is a Short come from YouTube.
product_videos_help: Up to {{max}} videos, long videos and Shorts together. The first one shows first on the product page.
product_video_already_added: This video is already on the product.
product_video_check_failed: The video could not be checked. Try again.
product_video_unavailable_help: YouTube no longer plays this video (made private or deleted), so the shop hides it. Remove it, or add another.
set_how_you_will_sign_in: Set how you will sign in to the admin
pin_must_be_6_digits: A PIN must be 6 digits, or leave it empty to skip it.
account_created_sign_in: Account created. Sign in to continue.
invalid_or_expired_invitation_link: That invitation link is not valid or has expired. Ask an administrator for a new one.
replacement_help: Optional. Empty means the old address answers 410 Gone.
lead_time_is_required: Enter the lead time for a made-to-order product.

selling_above_mrp: The selling price may not be above the MRP.
sku_frozen: A published product keeps its SKU.
saree_length_help: For example 5.5. Shoppers see it on the product page.
blouse_piece_help: Leave empty when the saree has no blouse piece.
size_guide_help: Written once here and shown on every product using this template. Leave it empty to hide the link.
language_help: Fields marked by this language change with it. Everything else is shared.
override_price_help: Empty uses the template amount. Whole rupees, tax included.
value_needs_name: {{code}} needs a name in this language
role_help_variation_axis: Creates a row below for every value, each with its own price, stock and images.
role_help_named_add_on: No extra rows. The choice is saved on the cart line.
role_help_filter_only: Shows as a shop filter and a product fact.
role_help_bundle_component_option: Used by a bundle. Creates no rows.
image_mode_help: Simple: one gallery. Compound: a gallery for each variant combination. Switching keeps the other mode’s images.
images_help: 3:4 portrait photos. Position 1 is the primary image for cards and search results.
alt_text_help: Empty uses the Media Library alt text shown in grey.
price_policy_help: Saved now. It becomes buyable when the pricing engine is live.
url_slug_help: The same in every language. If you change it, old addresses forward automatically.
url_slug_invalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only
category_slug_help: Renaming forwards old addresses in the same save.
also_appears_under_help: One category can sit in several places. Its main address stays the first one.
category_rejected: That could not be saved. Check the address, and that the category is empty before deleting it.
attribute_rejected: That could not be saved. A value used by a product can be hidden, not deleted.
go_live_blocked: This product cannot go live yet:
gap_addon_template: Choose a template for options that need measurements
image_not_portrait: Not 3:4, so it may be cropped: {{positions}}
role_name_variation_axis: Variation: creates a row per value
shop_name_help: Shown as text wherever no logo is set, and in search results.
full_logo_help: PNG with a clear background, at least 960 px wide, for wide places: the shop header, footer and popups. Dark: the same logo with light lettering, for dark screens such as the admin in dark mode; empty, the light logo keeps a white band. To change one, remove it first.
seal_help: Square PNG with a clear background, at least 512 px, for phones and the collapsed admin menu. Dark is optional; empty, the light one is used everywhere. To change one, remove it first.
seal_as_favicon: Also use it as the browser icon (favicon)
browser_icon_help: Square PNG, at least 512 px. The browser tab icon and the icon on a phone home screen. To change it, remove it first.
brand_shop_logos_help: Used by the shop, link previews and, unless switched below, the admin.
brand_admin_logos_help: For a shop whose admin carries another company's brand.
admin_own_logos: The admin uses its own logos
admin_own_logos_help: Off: the admin shows the shop logos above. On: each admin slot left empty still uses the shop one.
link_preview_picture_help: JPG or PNG, 1200 x 630 px. Shown when the home page, a category, a blog post or any page without its own picture is shared. Empty: the computer logo on white. To change it, remove it first.
social_profiles_help: Profile addresses, starting https://. Shown as footer icons and given to Google as the shop's own profiles; an empty one hides its icon. X posts from the share menu say "via" this X account (also shown in Storefront settings › Sharing). YouTube comes from Storefront settings › YouTube.
browser_bar_colour_help: The colour of the browser bar on phones and of the installed app's title bar.
brand_rejected: The Brand Kit was not saved. Check the profile addresses and pictures.
app_link_missing: No app at this address in the store. Check the address.
app_link_unknown: The store could not be reached. Try Validate again.
app_links_help: The app's store page address, such as https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shop.app or https://apps.apple.com/in/app/shop/id1234567890. Phones open it in their store app, computers on the store's website. Once saved, the footer shows that store's badge; an empty one hides it.
app_link_check_first: Validate the changed app links before saving.
admin_theme_colour_help: The colour of the admin: side menu, buttons, tabs, links and highlights. Changes show at once; Save keeps them.
role_change_confirm: Changing this role retires its saved variants. Continue?
gap_image_sizes: The primary image is still being prepared
no_dashboard_access: You do not have access to any home page widgets yet. Ask an administrator to grant them.
admin_restarting_text: This page will refresh by itself in a few seconds.
author: Author
cover_alt_help: Describe the picture for people who cannot see it and for Google. Saved on the picture in the media library.
blog_cover_help: *A 2:1 picture, at least 2400 × 1200 px. Keep the subject in the middle two-thirds.
blog_share_image_help: *The picture WhatsApp and Facebook show. Empty: the cover.
blog_slug_help: The address of the post, the same in both languages. Empty: made from the English title. Changing it keeps the old address working.
blog_excerpt_help: The short summary under the title. Empty: the opening of the article.
publish_date_help: Set when the post goes live. Pick an earlier date to back-date it, or a later one to schedule it.
blog_meta_title_help: Empty: the title followed by "| Saha Textile".
blog_term_slug_help: The address in the shop, the same in both languages. Empty: made from the English name.
blog_term_status_help: On shows it in the shop. It needs a name in every language.
blog_taken_down: The post is off the shop.
blog_rejected: That could not be saved. Check the address and the pictures.
blog_gap_image_sizes: The cover is still being prepared
blog_gap_category: Choose at least one live category
blog_gap_blog_category: A chosen category is not live
blog_gap_blog_tag: A chosen tag is not live
stores_order_help: Drag a row by its handle, or use the arrows, to change the order on the Contact Us page.
store_delete_message: Delete this store? Its photos stay in the media library.
landmark_help: Optional. Helps people find the door, for example: opposite Basanti Devi College.
pincode_invalid: A PIN code has six digits
google_maps_link_help: In Google Maps, open the store, press Share and copy the link.
store_phone_help: Indian numbers get +91 added automatically. Leave empty if not known yet; the store stays off the shop until it has one.
store_photos_help: Up to 8 landscape photos, at least 1600 px wide. The first one is the cover.
store_active_help: Shows on the Contact Us page. Needs {{languages}} complete and at least one open day.
store_go_live_done: The store shows on the Contact Us page
store_go_live_blocked: Not shown on the shop yet. Still needed:

search_word_gap_tags: A category or product to find
search_word_go_live_blocked: The search word cannot go live yet. Missing:

search_word_spellings_help: Other ways people write it in this language, separated by commas. Typos are forgiven without listing them.
search_word_categories_help: Every product in these categories, and in categories under them. The same in every language.
search_word_products_help: Single products to add on top of the categories.
search_word_status_help: Go Live needs the name in every language, and at least one category or product.
show_first_help: When the words fit two products equally well, products in these categories come first. Example: "banarasi" shows Banarasi sarees before Banarasi suits; "banarasi suit" still shows suits first.
storefront_settings_saved: Saved. The shop shows the changes within five minutes.
youtube_channel_help: The channel handle, starting with @. Changing it makes the next refresh look the channel up again.
youtube_rail_on_home: Show the rail on the home page
youtube_last_error: The last refresh failed: {{error}}. The shop keeps showing the videos it had.
youtube_refresh_help: The shop refreshes the list every night at 00:00 IST. Refresh now when a new video should show at once, or one was made private.
youtube_refresh_started: Refresh started. The list updates in about a minute.
youtube_refresh_failed: The refresh could not be started. Try again.
youtube_settings_rejected: The YouTube settings were not saved. Check the channel handle and the number of videos.
share_x_account_help: Named in X posts as "via @…". This is the X profile in Brand Kit: changing it here changes it there. Leave empty for none.
share_hashtags_help: Up to three tags from the product's facts, on X posts only.
share_apps_listed_help: Link and More apps are always there. On phones, Telegram, email, X, LinkedIn and Pinterest are reached through More apps.
share_settings_rejected: The Sharing settings were not saved. Check the X account: letters, numbers and _ only, up to 15.
storefront_settings_rejected: The settings were not saved. Please try again.

question_answered: Answer published. The customer has been emailed.
faq_show_on_page: Show FAQ on the product page

faq_category_help: Use the Language switch at the top to write each question in every language. Go Live needs them all.

event_ist_help: India time, whatever this computer is set to.

event_save_to_check: Save to see each item's readiness.
event_sale_products_help: A product picked here follows its own rule, before any category rule.
event_no_discounts: Pick categories or products to discount.
event_rule_order_help: A product's own rule wins, then an exception, then the category rule. In two categories, the lower price wins. Prices round down to whole rupees; add-ons are not discounted.
event_message_help: The popup's text and the email to customers who agreed to offers. Sent once, when you press Publish.
event_test_sent: Test message sent to your email
event_test_failed: The test message could not be sent

event_reach_other: The message will go to {{count}} customers who agreed to offers.

event_problem_bad_rule: The rule for {{item}} can never apply

swatch_from_library: Pick a swatch picture from the Media Library
swatch_choose: Use this photo as the swatch for {{value}}
swatch_picture_missing: No swatch picture yet. Go Live needs one.

file_name_rename_warning: Saving renames every size of this image in the background. Pages pick up the new name on their own.
caption: Caption

event_preview_help: Shows the saved popup on the shop in {{language}}, the language chosen above. The preview link works for 30 minutes.
event_preview_blocked: The browser blocked the preview window. Allow pop-ups for the admin and try again.

dark_mode: Switch between dark and light screens
locked_item: Built in: it cannot be changed or deleted
event_popup_pictures_help: Up to 5 pictures, portrait 3:4 (about 1200 × 1600). Several slide by themselves in the order shown. Without any, the popup shows text only.
event_picture_side_help: On computers. Phones and tablets show the pictures as a band above the text.

search_hint_customer_create: Add a customer account by hand.
search_hint_customer: Every customer account, including deleted ones you can restore.
search_hint_customer_ledger: A customer's points balance and the entries behind it.
search_hint_product_create: Create a product with its options, pictures and prices.

search_hint_redirect: Old addresses and where they now send visitors.

search_hint_category: Product categories and how they nest.
search_hint_tag: Product tags for grouping and search.
search_hint_qna: Shoppers' questions on products, and your answers.
search_hint_order: Every order, with status, payment and delivery.
search_hint_order_create: Place an order on a customer's behalf.
search_hint_media: Every uploaded picture, with its sizes and where it is used.
search_hint_blog: Blog posts, drafts and what is live.

search_hint_event: Launch and sale events, past and planned.

search_hint_event_create_sale: Plan a sale with its discounts and popup.
search_hint_currency: Currencies shoppers can pay in, and their rates.
search_hint_point: Add or take away reward points for a customer.
search_hint_review: Product reviews and photos waiting for approval.
search_hint_faq: Questions and answers on the FAQ page.
search_hint_theme_option: The shop theme's layout and display choices.
search_hint_home_banners: Home and category banners, including the newsletter popup picture.
search_hint_storefront_setting: Shop-wide choices for search, videos and sharing.
search_hint_setting_brand: Logos, browser icon, link preview picture, social profiles and app links.
search_hint_setting_stores: Your shops, their addresses and opening hours, shown on Contact Us.
search_hint_setting_mailboxes: Gmail mailboxes the Inbox reads and sends from.
search_hint_setting_communications: Which messages go out by email, SMS and WhatsApp.

shop_mode_switch: Show the light/dark switch in the shop
shop_mode_switch_help: On: shoppers can switch the shop between light and dark from the top bar. Off: everyone sees the site mode.
communications_intro: Choose which channels carry each message the shop sends. A yellow i means the message costs more or is promotional, and turning it on asks for your password. A red i means a security risk; those channels stay off.
comm_use_step_up_code: Code before a sensitive account change
comm_use_new_contact_code: Code to a new email or mobile number
comm_use_contact_change_warning: Warning to the old email or mobile number
comm_reason_phone_has_code: Off by choice: customers who use a phone already sign in with a code. Turning this on sends a reset link by text and adds cost.
comm_reason_email_proof: Security risk: this link proves the customer owns the email address. Sent to a phone, it would mark the email as verified without that proof, so someone could claim another person’s email.
comm_reason_staff_email_proof: Security risk: a staff invitation proves the person owns their work email. Sent to a phone, whoever holds that phone could set up an admin account.
comm_reason_payment_link_texts: Off by choice: payment links in text messages are what scammers copy. The customer already sees the failure on the checkout page.
comm_reason_sms_no_file: Off by choice: a text cannot carry the invoice file, so it would send a link instead, at extra cost.
comm_reason_not_urgent_cost: Off by choice: not urgent, and every message costs money.
comm_reason_sms_promotional_route: Operators may treat this as promotional: it then goes only to customers who agreed, between 10:00 and 21:00, at the promotional rate.
comm_reason_whatsapp_marketing_rate: Meta will likely charge this as marketing, about ₹0.86 a message instead of ₹0.115, and only to customers who agreed.
comm_reason_promotional_sms: Promotional: only to customers who agreed to marketing, sent between 10:00 and 21:00, charged per message.
comm_reason_promotional_whatsapp: Marketing on WhatsApp: only to customers who agreed, about ₹0.86 a message.
comm_reason_newsletter_email_only: A newsletter is a full email page. It cannot be sent as a text or WhatsApp message.
comm_confirm_password_only: Only your password confirms this, even if you usually sign in with your PIN.
comm_error_invalid_password: That password is not right. Nothing changed.
comm_error_locked: This channel stays off: it is a security risk.
comm_error_unavailable: This message cannot be sent on that channel.
comm_error_email_required: Codes always go by email as well, so email stays on.
comm_error_phone_channel_required: Keep SMS or WhatsApp on, so customers who use a phone still get their code.
comm_error_not_saved: The change was not saved. Please try again.
lang_intro: English is the default and is always on. A new language starts as a draft: write its text in every form, then switch it on for the shop when nothing is left to do. The Admin switch lets staff use the admin itself in that language.
lang_admin_text_missing: The admin's own words are not in this release yet.
lang_add_help: Only languages whose menu and button text came with the latest release can be added. It starts as a draft: nothing shows on the shop.
lang_none_to_add: Every language in this release is already added.
lang_area_shop_text: Shop menu and button text (comes with a release)
lang_area_admin_text: Admin menu and button text (comes with a release)
lang_admin_text_note: The admin's own words never stop the shop; they decide only the Admin switch.
lang_shop_blocked_title: {{language}} can't go on the shop yet
lang_shop_blocked_body_one: {{count}} thing is still empty in {{language}}. Every page, product and photo the shop shows must have its text first.
lang_shop_blocked_body_other: {{count}} things are still empty in {{language}}. Every page, product and photo the shop shows must have its text first.
lang_shop_on_body: Everything is filled in. The shop will show {{language}} at /{{code}}/…, list it in the language menu, and tell Google about the new pages.
lang_shop_off_body_one: Visitors and Google will be sent from every /{{code}}/… address to the same page in English, for good (301). {{count}} address is in the sitemap today.
lang_shop_off_body_other: Visitors and Google will be sent from every /{{code}}/… address to the same page in English, for good (301). {{count}} addresses are in the sitemap today.
lang_shop_off_keep: The text stays stored. Switching back on brings the pages back.
lang_delete_body_one: It leaves every list and switch in the admin and the shop. Its text stays stored: {{count}} item has {{language}} text. Adding {{language}} again brings it all back.
lang_delete_body_other: It leaves every list and switch in the admin and the shop. Its text stays stored: {{count}} items have {{language}} text. Adding {{language}} again brings it all back.
lang_delete_reminder: After 30 days unused, the bell reminds you every 30 days that its text is still stored, so you can erase it.
lang_erase_body_one: {{language}} was deleted on {{date}}. Its text is still stored in {{count}} item.
lang_erase_body_other: {{language}} was deleted on {{date}}. Its text is still stored in {{count}} items.
lang_erase_warning: Erasing can't be undone. The menu and button text in the code stays until a release removes it.
lang_reminder: {{language}} is deleted, but its text is still stored. Erase it or keep it.
lang_missing_filter: Showing only what is missing in {{language}}.
lang_error_english_fixed: English is always on and can't be changed.
lang_error_not_in_release: This language's menu and button text hasn't come with a release yet.
lang_error_admin_text_incomplete: The admin's menu and button text for this language is not complete yet.
lang_error_todo_left: Some text is still missing in this language.
lang_error_shop_on: Switch the shop off for this language first.
lang_error_not_deleted: Only a deleted language can be erased or kept.
lang_error_name_mismatch: Type the language's name exactly as shown.
lang_error_already_erased: This language's text is already erased.
lang_error_not_saved: The change was not saved. Please try again.
fm_trash_note: Items are removed for good 30 days after they were deleted.
fm_restore_folder_gone: Its old folder {{folder}} is in Trash too.
fm_restore_with_folder: Restore the folder as well, then put it back in it
fm_empty_body_one: {{count}} item will be deleted for good. This can’t be undone.
fm_empty_body_other: {{count}} items will be deleted for good. This can’t be undone.
fm_folder_name_help: Folder names are for you only. They never change any address on the website.
fm_kept_in_use_one: {{count}} image stayed because the website uses it.
fm_kept_in_use_other: {{count}} images stayed because the website uses them.
fm_trash_body: You can restore them for 30 days. After that they are removed for good.
fm_rename_file_help: Renaming is for finding it here. Website addresses and SEO names stay the same (edit those in Details).
fm_in_use_title: {{used}} of these {{total}} are used on the website
fm_in_use_title_one: This image is used on the website
fm_in_use_body: They can’t go to Trash while pages use them. Swap them out on those pages first.
fm_in_use_body_one: It can’t go to Trash while pages use it. Swap it out on those pages first.
fm_in_use_kept_folders: A folder that holds one stays where it is, with everything in it.
fm_move_others_one: Move the other one to Trash
fm_key_enter: Open the folder, or preview the file
fm_key_undo: Undo the last move, rename or Trash
fm_keys_note: ⌘ on a Mac, Ctrl on Windows. Keys do nothing while you are typing in a box.
fm_empty_hint: Drag files or folders here from your computer, or use Upload.
fm_photos_wait_note: Photos upload here once image profiles are added to Media.
fm_dup_identical_title: This file is already in Media
fm_dup_identical_body: The file you are uploading is exactly the same, byte for byte, as one already there.
fm_dup_name_title: A file with this name is already here
fm_dup_same_answer_one: Same answer for the other {{count}} file like this in this upload
fm_dup_same_answer_other: Same answer for the other {{count}} files like this in this upload
fm_dup_identical_note: Upload anyway keeps both. Replacing isn’t offered: the two are identical, so nothing would change.
fm_dup_keep_both_note: Upload anyway keeps both: the new one is saved as {{name}}.
fm_od_title: This upload goes past the {{plan}} plan
fm_od_note: Billed by DigitalOcean for as long as it stays stored. Deleting files brings it back under the plan.
fm_od_let_others: Also let other admins use on-demand storage
fm_od_let_others_help: They still see this question every time. Only super admins see this box, and can turn it off again in Storage details.
fm_refused_body: It would take storage about {{extra}} past the {{plan}} plan. Only a super admin can approve that, and other admins haven’t been allowed to use on-demand storage.
fm_refused_note: Nothing was uploaded. Ask a super admin, or free some space first.
fm_stored_as_is: Stored as it is: no second bar
fm_share_website_picture_help: The address the website already uses. It never expires.
fm_share_original_help: Exactly as uploaded. For a printer, a photographer or a marketplace.
fm_share_private_help: Admins see it in Media; anyone else needs a link you make
fm_share_public_help: A permanent web address, for linking from the website
fm_share_public_warning: Anyone with this address can open the file for as long as it is public. A public address can’t expire. Making the file private stops it within a minute (the cache is cleared); copies people already downloaded stay with them.
fm_share_public_note: Expiring links are for private files: while a file is public, its permanent address would keep working beside them.
fm_share_pick_date: Pick the date the link stops working.
fm_share_shown_once: Copy it now: the full link is shown only once. The list below names links by their last characters.
fm_share_links_help: These are our own links, not raw Spaces addresses: change the date or stop a link any time. Opening one hands the file over straight from Spaces for 5 minutes. Links stop when the file goes to Trash.
fm_share_copy_failed: The browser didn’t allow copying. Select the address and copy it by hand.
fm_storage_originals_note: The private masters every version is made from
fm_storage_trash_note: Freed when emptied, or after 30 days
fm_storage_reserved_note: Held against the plan until they finish
fm_storage_plan_note: {{plan}} stored and 1,024 GB sent out each month, shared by all buckets
fm_storage_past_plan_note: On-demand storage. You are asked before anything goes past {{plan}}.
fm_storage_others: Other admins may use on-demand storage
fm_storage_others_note: Super admins always can. Only a super admin can change this, here or from the on-demand question.
